canonical_project: Sky47 Karakoram-01 AI Data Centre Campus
notes: Located at Capital Smart City, Islamabad; Uptime Institute lists Sky47 Karakoram 1 (Islamabad) with Tier III Design Documents award. ZTE/Sky47 announced launch of Karakoram-01, Pakistan's first purpose-built AI-ready data centre campus, inaugurated 2026-07-24 by PM Shehbaz Sharif. 'Largest' claim contested in press; capacity not disclosed.
